Hero

The hero picture is drawn 700 by 200 and cropped to cover, the way a film site draws its poster.

Prose

Monarch butterflies migrate thousands of kilometres each autumn, navigating by the sun with a time-compensated compass in their antennae and arriving at the same mountain forests their great-grandparents left the spring before.

Milkweed is the only food of the larvae, and the cardenolides it holds make the adults distasteful to many birds, which learn to avoid the bright orange pattern after a single unpleasant meal.
